title: Fonts & Layouts
description: Use Unicode (U+0900–U+097F) Devanagari fonts for the modern web — searchable, copy-pasteable, and universally rendered. Legacy ASCII fonts (Preeti, Kantipur, PCS) re-map Latin slots to Devanagari shapes; converters are needed for any modern integration.

resources.name: Lohit Devanagari
resources.description: Red Hat / Fedora project. GPLv2. Reliable open Unicode Devanagari font.

resources.name: Madan Puraskar Pustakalaya
resources.description: Historical home of Nepali Unicode work. Maintains Kalimati, Aalekh, Madan, Sirjana, Sagarmatha fonts (GPL).

resources.name: Google Fonts — Devanagari
resources.description: Mukta, Hind, Khand, Tiro Devanagari Hindi, Noto Sans/Serif Devanagari, Anek Devanagari, Halant, Tillana, Palanquin, Vesper Libre, Ek Mukta, Teko, Kalam.

resources.name: Anjali Old Lipi
resources.description: Classic Devanagari Unicode font available via Adobe Fonts.

resources.name: mhnpd/nepali-font
resources.description: Collection of 60+ legacy Nepali fonts (Ananda family, Kantipur, Preeti, etc.) for reference. Mostly ASCII.

resources.name: MPP FontConverter
resources.description: Java-based converter from MPP — Preeti and other ASCII Nepali fonts to Unicode.
